cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.30)
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../templates/modules-starter/cmake/ImportStdGate.cmake)
project(coroutine-in-interface LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 26)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_MODULE_STD ON)
add_library(co)
target_sources(co PUBLIC FILE_SET CXX_MODULES FILES co.cppm)
add_executable(app main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE co)
